notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR11 space-fills DEBUG-ITEM before each execution, updates the members by MOVE rules, and moves DEBUG-CONTENTS "with no conversion of data from one form of internal representation to another". DebugItem.Set refills the five FILLERs and sets every member through Fit (unset DEBUG-SUB-n stay spaces), SubImage writes S9999 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE images, and DebugTriggerEmitter.DataItemImage passes the item's storage image (WholeItem keeps an ODO group's current extent); the witness shows spaces in DEBUG-SUB-1..3 for a procedure trigger. Probes at 85 (dbg/g11, g11b, g14): after MOVE ALL "#" TO DEBUG-ITEM in the section the next trigger shows spaces in the FILLERs and SUBs; a subscripted then an unsubscripted trigger leaves no stale SUB; COMP 258 and -1 round-trip byte-exact through DEBUG-CONTENTS (1:2) into a REDEFINES; PIC S99 -15 gives "1N"; edited -ZZ9.99 gives "- 12.50"; refmod store RM (2:1) gives the whole item; DEBUG-SUB-1 moved to 9(4) gives 0002; a reference outside a debugging section is refused (COBOL6442). DISPLAY of a space-filled DEBUG-SUB-n prints "+    ", as it does for any SIGN LEADING SEPARATE item holding spaces (a DISPLAY matter; the content is spaces, MOVE to X(5) and = SPACES both show it).

next.reason: 1985: "Prior to each execution of a debugging section, the content of the data item referenced by DEBUG-ITEM is space filled."; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the feature. No candidate mentions DEBUG-ITEM, DEBUG-CONTENTS or USE FOR DEBUGGING sections.". 2023 has no clause for the Debug module feature. The MOVE group-move wording is a different subject, and the USE rule is generic. The DEBUG-ITEM updating rule is dropped.
